newsitem.title: MEXICO: At least 16 die in Mexican truck crash.
newsitem.headline: At least 16 die in Mexican truck crash.

text.p: At least 16 people died when a speeding pick-up truck carrying 19 passengers overturned on a highway in the southern Mexican state of Oaxaca, state news agency Notimex reported late on Wednesday.
It said the dead included three children, seven school teachers, the driver and five peasants.
The accident occured just before the truck entered the town of Ixtlan, some 220 miles (350 kms) southeast of Mexico City, as it was headed toward the state capital Oaxaca.
The truck had license plates from Pennsylvania in the United States but no Americans were believed to be aboard.
